Story order is Tricorp, then Oscorp, then the Sinister Six. Otto worked at Tricorp before the series and later came to work for Norman Osborn at Oscorp; in episode 8 ('Reaction') he only breaks into Tricorp's Coney Island R&D building to steal his old Megalopack, so he never rejoins Tricorp after Oscorp. He turns on Osborn after the episode 8 accident and forms the Sinister Six in episode 11 ('Group Therapy'), so the leading Sinister Six stage before Oscorp is also wrong. The final group (The Sinister Six) is unchanged.

owner_calls.question: Marvel Database files the Spider-Verse films' Earth-1610 as 'Earth-1610B' (the page says it covers Earth-1610 as depicted in the films; the 'B' separates it from the comics' Ultimate Earth-1610, and its EarthNumber field is 1610). Should T:sv-doc-ock-itsv, T:sv-kingpin-itsv and T:sv-green-goblin-itsv stay Earth-1610 or become Earth-1610B?
options: Change to Earth-1610B (Marvel Database page suffix)
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database pages: Olivia Octavius (Earth-1610B), Wilson Fisk (Earth-1610B), Norman Osborn (Earth-1610B).

owner_calls.question: V1: this record merges two characters, twins Stan and Lee Patterson, whom Marvel Database files as separate people. The record is deliberately named as a pair ('The Human Flies'). Keep it as one pair record or split it into two people?
